symptom: The generated `.claude/bootstrap-mxcli.sh` defaulted `MXCLI_TAG` to `nightly` whatever mxcli wrote it, so a project initialised by a pinned release re-fetched the current nightly after every idle reap — a different mxcli from the one its tooling was written by (ChipCoV8/V9 bootstrap findings)
insight: Only a plain `vX.Y.Z` is a downloadable tag: `devcontainerReleaseTag`/`mxcliReleaseTag` strip a `-N-gHASH` suffix, which would map a dev build onto a release it is not — the bootstrap default must not do that, so it uses its own strict match and keeps nightly otherwise. The script is regenerated by `mxcli init` (not by `--sync-skills`), so the default is the release that last ran init
